morning.caption:
Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share, raising $81 billion, the largest listing on record, at a value near $1.5 trillion. It starts trading on the Nasdaq today as ANT. Nasdaq 100 futures rose 1.83% early Thursday. Amazon owns 14.7% and Google 13.7%, so most index funds already hold a slice.

Our read, labeled as judgment: expect a volatile first week. General information, not investment advice. More at fiopoin.com

midday.caption:
Fed minutes say nearly all officials see more rate hikes as possibly necessary. Traders price a near certain quarter point hike on December 9 (market odds, LSEG via Reuters). The 10 year Treasury closed at 5.10%. Credit cards and HELOCs follow the Fed, mortgages follow the 10 year. One bright spot: gas is $3.75 (AAA). General information, not financial advice. evening.caption:
Trump, Xi and Putin met together for the first time and issued a peace declaration backing stable energy flows, per Chinese state media. Brent slipped to $91.70 as US crude stocks rose, while Iran's navy reportedly said mines disabled three tankers near Hormuz. Gas is $3.75 (AAA).
